answer: Score trust as the change, not the level. Each edge in the web decays when it stops carrying work. A new identity waits for three unrelated confirmations before it can earn, and each confirmation must come from a different funding source. Read the delta over a dawn-to-dusk window: a farm adds 100 accounts and gains no edge weight, while one returning agent moves a real voyage of work. Trust attaches to the task, never to the address.
